item.title: Weekly Moment With the Rebbe
item.description: Women in the army. Denial of a blessing. How did the Rebbe’s reaction leave an indelible mark? The Avner Institute presents a series of anecdotes from those, young or old, who merited an audience in the Rebbe’s office and to this day remember his holy words, and his quiet yet powerful presence. Full Story

item.title: L’Chaim: Holzman – Goldsobel
item.description: The L'Chaim of Mendel Holzman of Crown Heights and Tammy Goldsobel of London, UK took place at Ulam Chana Hall in Crown Heights. Photos

item.title: Yud Shvat Celebrated at Cheder Chabad of Monsey
item.description: Yud Shvat in Cheder Chabad of Monsey was celebrated across each division with special Hachana programs and the practical preparations for the events of the day. Full Story

item.title: Just the Simple Acts: Chabad of Northeast Iowa Part II
item.description: Illuminations #211 a weekly publication by COLlive.com and DollarDaily.org: Rabbi Aron and Yehudit Schimmel share stories and moments of Shlichus from Chabad of Northeast Iowa, Postville, IA. Full Story

item.title: Accuracy Vs. Sensitivity in Krias HaTorah?
item.description: Question: When should a bar mitzvah boy be corrected during leining? Answer by Rabbi Mendel Prescott, Rosh Yeshiva of Machon Smicha. Full Story

item.title: Rabbi Krinsky’s Statement on 770 Car Ramming
item.description: Merkos Chairman Rabbi Yehuda Krinsky released a statement following the car ramming at 770 Eastern Parkway - Chabad Headquarters and called for prompt, decisive action by the justice system to discourage further incidents and ensure public safety. Full Story

item.title: After Reopening, 770 Celebrates at Yud Shvat Farbrengen
item.description: Hours after being reopened after being evacuated due to ramming attack, 770 Eastern Parkway was filled with a joyous farbrengen celebrating Yud Shvat, the Yom Hilula of the Frierdiker Rebbe and the day the Rebbe assumed leadership. Photos, Video

item.title: Show Up and Say Yes for Bonei Olam
item.description: For Bonei Olam Chabad, showing up is the foundation of what propels hope forward. The 5th Annual Bonei Olam Chabad Women’s Show Up Event will take place Monday evening, February 16, at Oholei Torah. Full Story

item.title: Merkos Chinuch Office to Host Two-Part Chinuch Training
item.description: The Merkos Chinuch Office will be hosting a two-part Chinuch program designed to accommodate both morning and afternoon Mechanchos so they can attend when not teaching, as well as Mechanchos and Menahalos who are in town for the Kinus Hashluchos. Each part addresses the same core ideas and chinuch goals. Full Story

item.description: Sights and scenes from preparations on Friday for Shabbos Beshalach 5786 in the Crown Heights neighborhood. Photos
